title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：rain　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the ranger ① caught the rain that no villager in the valley would have described, and he said the catching was the whole of the season. The ② rain, meaning the shower itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; rain, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of rain in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ rain at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Rain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the ranger said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rain was the whole of the matter, meaning the blessing and not the shower. The ⑥ rain, meaning the blessing and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; rain, he said, is either something you catch or the only word that means both shower and a blessing. He said the blessing is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ rain had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ rain of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of describing; rain, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rain I remember is the rain described in the survey, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Rain, my mother said in 1997, is the only thing that improves by being described; all rain, she said, is a blessing that has agreed to look like shower. She said the blessing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雨（指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 雨（指那场雨本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：catch the rain 接这一场雨
D. n. 雨（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 雨之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的雨之事）
F. n. 雨（指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一场）
G. n. 雨、甘霖（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 甘霖（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: caught the rain that no villager in the valley would have described
The rain, meaning the shower itself and not the staff
Every sort of rain in that valley
the rain at the far ridge
the rain was the whole of the matter
the rain had become a line in a survey
The rain of the whole thing

answers.why: catch the rain 意为“接这一场雨”，1988 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一场雨做了一遍。
rain 意为“雨”，指那场雨本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。
rain 意为“雨”，指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
rain 意为“雨”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rain 意为“雨、甘霖”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场甘霖就是那件事的全部。
rain 意为“甘霖”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场雨，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rain 意为“雨”，指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一场，到 1993 年这一场成了踏勘记录里的一行。
rain 意为“雨之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的雨之事是一处山谷和三个季节的描述。
rain 意为“雨”，我记得的是踏勘记录里描述过的那一场，1995 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一场。
rain 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，雨是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的雨。
